en: Vintage sepia postcard showing an outdoor swimming pool complex surrounded by trees and lawns. People are swimming in the rectangular pools and sunbathing on the grass and benches in the foreground. On the right side are tiered wooden or concrete stands, and paths lead around the pool area. The front caption at the bottom reads "Pécs" on the left and "Balokány-ligeti strand" on the right. The reverse side is a standard divided postcard back with vertical publisher information in Hungarian and lines for address and message.
